<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<addon id="plugin.video.xtreammate"
       name="XCMate"
       version="0.1.29.83"
       provider-name="GS Media">

  <requires>
    <import addon="xbmc.python" version="3.0.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.pil" version="5.1.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.requests" version="2.27.0" optional="true"/>

</requires>

  <extension point="xbmc.python.pluginsource" library="default.py">
    <provides>video audio</provides>
  </extension>

  <extension point="xbmc.service" library="service.py" start="startup"/>

  <extension point="xbmc.addon.metadata">
    <summary lang="en_GB">XCMate – TV setup wizard for Xtream, M3U and Stalker</summary>
    <summary lang="de_DE">XCMate – IPTV-Einrichtungsassistent mit Xtream, M3U und Stalker</summary>
    <description lang="en_GB">
      Independent GPL-licensed derivative of mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi, featuring a guided IPTV import process and on-video remote-control live channel and category navigation.
      Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series),
      XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings,
      reminders, sleep timer.
    </description>
    <description lang="de_DE">
      Eigenständiger GPL-Fork von mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi mit geführter IPTV-Einrichtung und Fernbedienungssteuerung über laufendem Live-TV.
      Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien),
      XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen,
      Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
    </description>
    <platform>all</platform>
    <license>GPL-2.0-only</license>
    <defaultlanguage>resource.language.en_gb</defaultlanguage>
    <forum>https://forum.kodi.tv</forum>
    <website>https://kodi.tv</website>
    <source>https://github.com/artattakk-creator/kodi-noodleprivate</source>
    <news>0.1.29.83: Eigene Auswahl für internen Android-Speicher. Quelle und Ziel vor jedem Schreibtest vergleichen; gleicher oder unklarer Speicherpool blockiert die Migration. Bestätigter 4-KiB-Test, bestehendes Kopier-/SHA256-/Anzeigejournal und begrenzte SQLite-BUSY-Wiederholungen. Verständliche Rechte-/Reservefehler. Originalbilder, Token, EPG und Kodi-Einstellungen bleiben erhalten. Keine SAF-Rechteumgehung. Android-Abnahme ausstehend.</news>
    <assets>
      <icon>icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png</icon>
      <fanart>resources/media/lightweight_splash.jpg</fanart>
    </assets>
  </extension>

</addon>

src/plugin.video.xtreammate/changelog.tx.old:
0.1.29.83
- Eigener Menüpunkt Interner Android-Speicher mit erreichbaren Ordnern statt /storage-Fallback.
- Schreibfreie Mount-/Device-/Kapazitätsprüfung; gleicher oder unklarer Pool blockiert.
- Bestätigter 4-KiB-Test im eigenen Zielnamespace; keine Android-SAF-Rechteumgehung.
- Kopierjournal, SHA256, bestätigte Bildanzeige und sichere Wiederaufnahme erhalten.
- SQLite-BUSY begrenzt behandeln; Rechte-, Reserve- und Renderfehler verständlich anzeigen.
- Originale, Profile, EPG, Token, Widgets und Installer .5.26 unverändert erhalten.
- ANDROID_NOT_TESTED; kein automatischer Merge und keine Veröffentlichung.

0.1.29.82
- Artwork-Worker respektiert Datenbankpausen, bleibt aktiv und setzt kontrolliert fort.
- Vorhandene Kodi-Texturen ohne Bildkopie und ohne Artwork-DB wiederverwenden.
- Speicherdiagnose für tatsächliches Zielvolume, Reserven und geschützte Schreibprobe.
- Lokale Katalogreihen unabhängig von neuen Hintergrunddownloads früh veröffentlichen.
- Gleiche Katalogrevision bewahrt bestätigte lokale Bildrollen bei Teilantworten.
- Keine automatische Speicherumstellung, Datenlöschung oder Kanalveröffentlichung.
- Android ANDROID_NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.81
- Bestätigte Bilder in einem quellen- und kontogebundenen lokalen Rendercache erhalten.
- Deterministische Eventbild-Auswahl, eigene TMDB-Diagnose und zusätzliche Hero-Backdrops.
- Kompakte native Film-/Serienreihen; Full-bleed-Hero und proportionaler Poster-Fallback.
- Katalogscan still, optionale kleine Statuszeile und verifizierter Abschlussbericht.
- Keine Daten-/Token-/SkinShortcuts-Resets; Android ANDROID_NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.80
- Revisionssichere Providercover, unabhängige Senderlogos und Last-good-Eventbilder.
- Home-Widget-/Film-Detailübergabe ohne rekursiven Verzeichnisanker.
- Geteilte EPG-Miss-Leases, nicht blockierende DB-Schreiber und endliche eigene Bildsuche.
- Full-bleed-Hero/Poster-contain, sofortige Filmreihe, korrekter EPG-Senderfokus und graublauer Fokus.
- Bestehende Daten/Token/Widgets/Installer unverändert; Android NOT_TESTED.

0.1.29.79
- Reannounce unchanged widget frames after cold start; confirm actual directory generations in native controls.
- Recover verified existing Kodi thumbnail files for exact provider/item/profile without changing storage mode or deleting images.
- Per-channel EPG read backoff and exact tvg/xmltv identifiers; keep manual mappings authoritative.
- Preserve personal widgets, Space Blue, token and Installer .5.26; Android acceptance pending.

0.1.29.78 (#385; kumulativ auf .77)
- Vollständiger Home-/Includes-/Variablenvertrag, gesicherte eigene Skin-Hook-Reparatur und tatsächlich geladene Controls als Gate.
- Bestehende Reihen/Neu im Kino erhalten, lokales privates Konfigurationsinventar; nur eigene generierte Reload-Consumer reparieren.
- Providercover: öffentliche Bildparameter erlauben, vorübergehenden DNS-Fehler von unsicherem Ziel unterscheiden; stale Kataloggenerationen abweisen.
- Exakte EPG-Referenzen vor sicherer HTTPS-Prüfung normalisieren; aktuelle Quelle hinter abgelaufener Aliaszeile nicht verdecken.
- Native BINGIE-Home als Navigationsanker erhalten; Builtin/Plugin-URL trennen und quoten.
- Ausstehendes natives ACK ist keine Stop-Fehlentscheidung; verspätetes bestätigtes ACK schließt denselben Job ohne Doppelstop ab.
- Installer 0.5.26, Token, alle bestehenden Daten und Einstellungen erhalten. Android-P0-Abnahme offen.

0.1.29.77 (Pilot-Test, #380 / #366 / #367 / #368)
- Vorhandenen gültigen TMDB-Token read-only übernehmen und Lookup einmalig freischalten; TVMaze-Serienfallback automatisch, bewusste Opt-outs erhalten.
- Vollständige Bilddekodierung vor Freigabe, geprüfte Redirects und begrenzte Erneuerung abgelaufener Event-URL-Leases; negative Caches nach Quellfreigabe erneut prüfen.
- Serien-/Film-Exit: Fortschritt vorab sichern, Android-Vollbild kontrolliert freigeben, genau ein nativer Stop mit FIFO-ACK; keine Player-Abfragen während unbestätigtem Stop.
- Bekannte Space-Blue-Home-Variante exakt unterstützen; Vorschau, Sicherung und Zustimmung erhalten, Hero-Bild flächig bei unveränderter Geometrie. Fehlende Controls separat diagnostizieren.
- EPG-Lesezugriffe kurz und generationsgebunden zusammenfassen; fehlende Kodi-Bibliotheksviews nur diagnostizieren.
- Installer 0.5.26, Profile, Passwörter, Token, EPG-Zuordnungen und Originalgrafiken unverändert. Android-P0-Abnahme ausdrücklich noch offen.

0.1.29.76 (unveröffentlichter Testkandidat, Folgeauftrag zu #367)
- Verifizierte Bild- oder neutrale Fallback-Vorbereitung gibt die nächste Hintergrundphase frei, ohne unsichtbare Leisten als gerendert zu melden.

import hashlib,json,time,threading
KEY='XCMate.Home75.Schedule'

_seen={}

def _window():

        return value if isinstance(value,dict) else {}
    except (ValueError,TypeError,AttributeError,RuntimeError):return {}

def trace(stage,**facts):
    allowed={'START_GROUP_KNOWN','LIVE_HOME_READY','MOVIE_WARM_BEGIN','MOVIES_PREPARED',
             'MOVIES_VISIBLE_READY','SERIES_WARM_BEGIN','SERIES_PREPARED','SERIES_VISIBLE_READY',
             'REST_WARM_BEGIN','MOVIES_DISABLED','SERIES_DISABLED','FOCUS_OVERRIDE','VISIBLE5_QUEUED','RENDER_PENDING','RENDER_CONTROL_MISSING'}
    if stage not in allowed:return
    safe={k:v for k,v in facts.items() if k in ('elapsed_ms','count','phase','queue_depth') and type(v) in (int,float)}
    signature=(stage,tuple(safe.items()));now=time.monotonic()
    if now-_seen.get(signature,-1e9)<30:return
    _seen[signature]=now
    while len(_seen)>64:_seen.pop(next(iter(_seen)))
    import xbmc
    try:xbmc.log('[XCMate][HOME75] stage='+stage+' '+json.dumps(safe,separators=(',',':')),xbmc.LOGINFO)
    except (AttributeError,RuntimeError):pass

              p.get('include_vod',True),p.get('include_series',True)) for p in portals]]

"""Persistent budgeted artwork. GUI receives LOCAL paths exclusively."""
import hashlib
import os
import struct
import sqlite3
import threading
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

_lock=threading.RLock()
_queue_lock=threading.RLock()
MAX_BYTES=3*1024*1024
MAX_PIXELS=8*1024*1024
_worker=None
_enrol_worker=None
_inbox={}
_serial=0
_enqueue_code='NOT_REQUESTED'
_choices={}
_choice_revision=0
MAX_INBOX=2048
_stop=__import__('threading').Event()


def dimensions(data):
    if data.startswith(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n') and len(data)>=24:
        return struct.unpack('>II',data[16:24])
    if data.startswith(b'\xff\xd8'):
        p=2
        while p+4<=len(data):
            if data[p]!=255: break
            while p<len(data) and data[p]==255: p+=1
            if p>=len(data): break
            marker=data[p]; p+=1
            if marker in (0xd9,0xda): break
            if marker in (0x01,0xd8) or 0xd0<=marker<=0xd7: continue
            if p+2>len(data): break
            length=int.from_bytes(data[p:p+2],'big')
            if length<2 or p+length>len(data): break
            if marker in (0xc0,0xc1,0xc2) and length>=7:
                h,w=struct.unpack('>HH',data[p+3:p+7]); return w,h
            p+=length
    raise ValueError('unsupported image')


def folder():
    from artwork_backend import active_backend
    return active_backend().resolve_target()


def cached(url):
    if not isinstance(url,str) or not url: return ''
    from artwork_backend import active_backend
    storage=active_backend();ident=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest()
    if (getattr(storage,'is_external',False) is True):
        from artwork_visible import external
        return external(storage,ident)
    return _cached_at(storage,ident)


def _cached_at(storage,ident):
    try:
        header=storage.read(ident,65536)
        w,h=dimensions(header)
        return storage.make_display_uri(ident) if 0<w<=4096 and 0<h<=4096 and w*h<=MAX_PIXELS else ''
    except (OSError,ValueError): return ''


def valid_source(value):
    if not isinstance(value,str) or not value or len(value)>8192 or any(ord(c)<32 or ord(c)==127 for c in value):return False
    try:
        parts=urlsplit(value)
        return parts.scheme in ('http','https') and bool(parts.hostname) and not any(c.isspace() for c in parts.hostname) and (parts.port is None or 0<parts.port<65536)
    except ValueError:return False


def fetch(url):
    """Worker-only. Stable names, no eviction, capacity checked before/after IO."""
    from art_storage import check,ArtworkFailure
    from artwork_config import persistent
    if not persistent():raise ArtworkFailure('MODE_CHANGED')
    from art_diagnostics import publish
    if not valid_source(url):raise ArtworkFailure('INVALID_SOURCE')
    from artwork_backend import active_backend
    storage=active_backend();ident=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest()
    from artwork_gate import writer
    with _lock,writer():
        hit=_cached_at(storage,ident)
        if hit:
            from art_store import ready
            ready(url,storage.stat(ident)['bytes']);return hit
        from art_store import budget,used
        publish('transfer','FETCH_BEGIN',expected_bytes=MAX_BYTES)
        try:
            cap=budget()
            if cap and used()>=cap:raise ArtworkFailure('BUDGET_FULL')
            check(MAX_BYTES,limit=0,backend=storage)
            # READY metadata remains internal even with a future external
            # image adapter. Retain its independent small-write preflight.
            from artwork_db import path as jobs_path
            from import_budget import check_space
            try:check_space(jobs_path(),65536)
            except OSError as error:
                if error.errno==28:raise ArtworkFailure('DISK_FULL','METADATA_RESERVE_BLOCKED') from None
                raise
            from utils import http_get
            try:data,_=http_get(url,timeout=4,max_bytes=MAX_BYTES,max_seconds=6,retry_limit=0)
            except ValueError:raise ArtworkFailure('INVALID_IMAGE') from None
            except Exception as error:
                from art_errors import classify,retry_after
                failure=ArtworkFailure(classify(error));failure.retry_after=retry_after(error)
                raise failure from None
            try:
                w,h=dimensions(data)
                if len(data)>MAX_BYTES or not 0<w<=4096 or not 0<h<=4096 or w*h>MAX_PIXELS:raise ValueError()
            except (ValueError,TypeError,struct.error):raise ArtworkFailure('INVALID_IMAGE') from None
            check(len(data),limit=cap,used=used() if cap else 0,backend=storage)
            def valid(raw):
                width,height=dimensions(raw)
                return 0<width<=4096 and 0<height<=4096 and width*height<=MAX_PIXELS
            filename=storage.write_verified(ident,data,valid)
        except ArtworkFailure as failure:
            publish('transfer',failure.code,reason=failure.reason,**failure.storage)
            raise
        except OSError as exc:
            code=getattr(exc,'code',None) or ('DISK_FULL' if exc.errno==28 else 'CACHE_ERROR')
            reason='PHYSICAL_ENOSPC' if exc.errno==28 else ''
            publish('transfer',code,reason=reason)
            raise ArtworkFailure(code,reason) from None
        from art_store import ready
        ready(url,len(data))

def path(pid,kind=None):

"""One stable ListItem contract for old plugin URLs and live Home publication."""
import os
from urllib.parse import urlencode


def describe(portal,kind,row,approved,epg=None,assets47=None):
    from widget_art44 import art
    from theme_render import snapshot
    from theme_store import asset
    from media_data import recent_label
    from utils import setting_int
    import xbmcaddon
    image=art(dict(row,kind=kind),approved);theme=snapshot()
    if kind in ('live','vod','series') and assets47:
        poster=assets47.get('poster');fanart=assets47.get('fanart')
        if poster:image.update(poster=poster,thumb=poster,icon=poster)
        if fanart:image.update(fanart=fanart,landscape=fanart)
        elif poster:image['landscape']=poster
    provider80=__import__('home_publication80').capture(row,image)
    if assets47:
        from render_cache81 import record_for
        from programme_assets47 import sources,fingerprint
        for role,source in sources(row,provider_only=True).items():
            proof81=record_for(portal,kind,row,role,source)
            if proof81 and proof81.get('file')==image.get(role):
                provider80[role]=dict(source=proof81.get('source81') or fingerprint(source),uri=proof81['file'])
    supplement81=__import__('media_hero81').reference(portal,kind,row) if kind in ('vod','series') and not image.get('fanart') else ''
    if supplement81:image.update(fanart=supplement81,landscape=supplement81)
    placeholder=os.path.join(xbmcaddon.Addon().getAddonInfo('path'),'resources','media',{'live':'tv','series':'series'}.get(kind,'vod')+'.png')
    if theme:
        if image['landscape']==placeholder or image['landscape'].startswith(str(theme['folder'])+'/'):
            image['landscape']=asset('widget.live' if kind=='live' else 'widget.series' if kind=='series' else 'widget.movie',image['landscape'],snapshot=theme)
        image['banner']=asset('widget.header',snapshot=theme)
    props={'XCMate.WidgetKind41':kind,'XCMate.PortalId':str(portal['id']),'XCMate.MediaId':str(row['sid']),
           'XCMate.Account':str(portal.get('name','')),'IsPlayable':'true' if kind=='live' else 'false'}
    params=dict(action=('play_live' if portal.get('type')=='xtream' else 'source_play') if kind=='live' else 'media_detail',pid=portal['id'],sid=row['sid'])
    if kind=='live':
        from widget_focus41 import token
        params['name']=row['name'];props['XCMate.LogoScale41']='0.5';props['XCMate.WidgetToken41']=token(portal,row)
    else:params['kind']=kind
    url='plugin://plugin.video.xtreammate/?'+urlencode(params)
    props['XCMate.ClickTarget44']=url
    info=dict(title=str(row['name']),plot=str(row.get('plot') or '')[:8192],mediatype={'vod':'movie','series':'tvshow','live':'video'}[kind])
    for key in ('genre','year','rating','duration'):
        if row.get(key) is not None:info[key]=row[key]
    if kind in ('vod','series'):
        # Provider numeric strings/duration text are not Kodi InfoTag values.
        # Reuse the normal movie contract; leave the successful series path.
        from media_data import video_info
        normalized=video_info(row)
        for key in ('genre','year','rating','duration'):
            info.pop(key,None)
            if key in normalized:info[key]=normalized[key]
        cast75=normalized.get('cast')
        if isinstance(cast75,str):cast75=[v.strip() for v in cast75.split(',') if v.strip()]
        if isinstance(cast75,list):
            info['cast']=[(str(v.get('name','')) if isinstance(v,dict) else str(v))[:128] for v in cast75[:24] if isinstance(v,(str,dict))]
        director75=normalized.get('director')
        if isinstance(director75,str):info['director']=director75[:256]
        if isinstance(row.get('mpaa'),str):info['mpaa']=row['mpaa'][:64]
        genre=info.get('genre')
        if genre is not None and not (isinstance(genre,str) or isinstance(genre,list) and all(isinstance(g,str) for g in genre)):
            info.pop('genre',None)
    if epg:
        from app_routes import guide_plot
        info['plot']=epg.get('_plot45') or guide_plot(epg)
        values=dict(Now=epg['now'],Next=epg['next'],Start=epg['start'],Stop=epg['stop'],Progress=epg['progress'] if epg['progress'] is not None else '')
        props.update({'XtreamMate.'+k:str(v) for k,v in values.items()})
        props['XtreamMate.NowTime']=epg.get('now_time','');props['XtreamMate.NextTime']=epg.get('next_time','')
        props['XCMate.EpgPercent41']=str(round(epg['progress']*100)) if isinstance(epg['progress'],(int,float)) else ''
    if kind!='live':
        label=recent_label(row,setting_int('recent_days',10));props['XCMate.AddedStatus']=label
        info['plot']=label+'\n'+info['plot']
    props['XCMate.MediaHeroSource81']='TMDB' if supplement81 else 'Provider'
    if kind=='series':
        from series_art64 import inspect,note
        props['XCMate.SeriesArt64']=inspect(row,image);note(props['XCMate.SeriesArt64'])
    if kind in ('vod','series') and __import__('widget_assets69').home():
        from widget_assets69 import renderable
        image={k:(v if renderable(v) else '') for k,v in image.items()}
        props['XCMate.ArtPending69']='false' if image.get('poster') else 'true'
    value=dict(label=str(row['name']),url=url,art=image,info=info,props=props,_provider80=provider80)
    if kind=='live':
        from programme_widgets46 import decorate
        value=decorate(value,portal,row,epg or {})
    return value


def item(value):
    import xbmcgui
    li=xbmcgui.ListItem(value['label'],path=value['url'])
    li.setArt(value['art']);li.setInfo('video',value['info'])
    for key,text in value['props'].items():li.setProperty(key,str(text))
    if value.get('menus46'):li.addContextMenuItems(value['menus46'])
    return li

"""Public provider-reference stale-while-revalidate, independent of title rows.

Only previously DNS-approved, exact account/profile/source references. A
positive lease may bridge a bounded 300s refresh gap; confirmed unsafe DNS
revokes immediately. No image files, global cache reset or programme DB writes.
"""
import json,os,time,hashlib,tempfile
from collections import OrderedDict
_cache=OrderedDict()
GRACE=300

def path(portal,kind):
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    from widget_policy74 import signature
    key=signature(portal,kind)
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'widget-refs74-'+key[:32]+'.json'),key

def read(portal,kind,rows):
    from widget_assets69 import safe
    from programme_assets47 import sources
    from artwork_visible import KODI_OPTIONS,_dns_cache,_lock
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    filename,context=path(portal,kind)
    try:
        stamp=os.stat(filename)
        hit=_cache.get(filename)
        if hit and hit[0]==(stamp.st_mtime_ns,stamp.st_size):value=hit[1]
        else:
            with open(filename,encoding='utf-8') as stream:raw=stream.read(262145)
            value=json.loads(raw) if len(raw)<=262144 else {}
            _cache[filename]=((stamp.st_mtime_ns,stamp.st_size),value)
            while len(_cache)>16:_cache.popitem(last=False)
        if value.get('context')!=context:return {}
        result={};now=time.time()
        for row in rows:
            for role,source in sources(row,provider_only=True).items():
                reference=value.get('refs',{}).get(str(row['sid']),{}).get(role,{})
                if reference.get('source')!=source or not safe(portal,source):continue
                if not now<reference.get('until',0)<=now+GRACE+30:continue
                host=urlsplit(source).hostname
                with _lock:known=_dns_cache.get((host,443))
                if known and known[0]>time.monotonic() and not known[1] and not __import__('dns_verdict78').temporary((host,443)):continue
                result.setdefault(str(row['sid']),{})[role]=source+KODI_OPTIONS
        return result
    except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,AttributeError):return {}

def revoked(source):
    from artwork_visible import _dns_cache,_lock
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    try:
        with _lock:known=_dns_cache.get((urlsplit(source).hostname,443))
        return bool(known and known[0]>time.monotonic() and not known[1] and not __import__('dns_verdict78').temporary((urlsplit(source).hostname,443)))
    except (ValueError,TypeError):return True

def remember_many(portal,kind,records):
    # Optional reference journal cannot terminate the actual artwork worker.
    try:return _remember_many(portal,kind,records)
    except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,RuntimeError,TimeoutError,AttributeError):return

def _remember_many(portal,kind,records):
    if not records:return
    from widget_assets69 import safe
    from profile_transaction import writing
    with writing(timeout=.1):
        filename,context=path(portal,kind)
        try:
            with open(filename,encoding='utf-8') as stream:value=json.loads(stream.read(262145))
        except (OSError,ValueError):value={}
        if value.get('context')!=context:value=dict(context=context,refs={})
        now=time.time();refs=value['refs'];changed=False
        refs={sid:{k:v for k,v in roles.items() if v.get('until',0)>now} for sid,roles in refs.items()}
        refs={sid:roles for sid,roles in refs.items() if roles}
        for sid,role,source,remaining in records:
            if not remaining or not safe(portal,source):continue
            old=refs.get(str(sid),{}).get(role,{})
            until=now+min(30,remaining)+GRACE
            if old.get('source')==source and old.get('until',0)>until-15:continue
            refs.setdefault(str(sid),{})[role]=dict(source=source,until=until);changed=True
        if not changed or len(refs)>512:return
        value['refs']=refs;raw=json.dumps(value,separators=(',',':')).encode()
        if len(raw)>262144:return
        fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.widget-refs74-',dir=os.path.dirname(filename))
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:stream.write(raw);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            os.replace(temp,filename)
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(temp):os.unlink(temp)
